subject: QuickFin demo sync — use case & availability
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: James Li <james.li@quickfin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QuickFin demo sync — quick fit questions before booking

Hi James —

Thanks for signing up and trying Redwood this morning. Quick note from our side: before I lock a demo slot with our solutions engineer, can you confirm three quick things so we make the session actionable?

- Primary use case: what feature are you planning to build first (e.g., customer support summarization, agent assist, search relevance)?
- Expected peak tokens / concurrent requests (rough numbers are fine) — helps me pick the right instance type.
- Timeline: pilot this quarter, next quarter, or longer? Any external deadlines?

If you prefer, drop a 30–min window and I’ll match the right engineer. I’ve cc'd Ben (SDR) to help with scheduling.

Attachments: I attached a short intake form and an example traffic CSV — feel free to paste numbers.

Best,
Irene Choi
SDR, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: James Li <james.li@quickfin.com>

Cc: Aisha Kaur <aisha@quickfin.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-02T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuickFin demo sync — quick fit questions before booking

Thanks Irene — quick answers below.

- Use case: agent assist for our payments reconciliation team (automated reconciliation summaries + suggested exception resolutions).
- Volume: peak ~1200 req/min during settlement windows; ~30M tokens/day across batch and interactive flows (estimate). Concurrently ~25 active agent sessions during peaks.
- Timeline: pilot in late July, aim for production pilot by end of Q3.

We can do a demo next week. Our availability: Wed 7/4 after 10am PT or Thu 7/5 between 9–12pm PT. If you need raw logs or a small sample CSV I can attach.

—James
James Li
Head of Platform Integrations, QuickFin
james.li@quickfin.com
